messages:
nina: Quick note - customer reported a spike in billed tokens after their streaming session was truncated and a deferred toolcall came back. Looks like overlapping bytes were billed twice.

leo: Can you share the trace id / session id? Is this the padding + toolcall path?

nina: trace=tr-55 session=ss-44. Repro pattern: client receives EOF at token 150 (server truncated), router retries, toolcall finishes on retry path and charges toolcall tokens ~40 which include the 10-token padding that overlapped with the truncated stream. Ledger shows both entries.

sam: Two quick directions: 1) router should carry a stable origin_id across retries so we can dedupe, 2) ledger finalization can subtract overlap if we detect a toolcall landed after a truncation marker.

leo: origin_id propagation is ideal but touchy; it will require touching several proxies. Subtraction at ledger finalize seems lower risk but we must ensure idempotency.

devex-jess: UX idea - show a temporary "estimated" bill in the console for active sessions and mark toolcalls as pending. That reduces support churn. We can add a tooltip explaining possible reversal when toolcalls finalize.

nina: I'll open an infra ticket to capture traces for a week to quantify scope. Meanwhile sam, can you prototype ledger finalize subtract logic? Maybe gated behind a feature flag.

sam: Yep. Plan: detect toolcall events with parent_session or origin, compute overlap with last-truncated-offset, if overlap>0 then emit a correction ledger entry with negative provisional tokens and mark final once settled. Feature flag: "toolcall_overlap_correction_v1". Add unit tests around retries creating different parent_session values.

ops-bot: Incident logged: INC-31501 "Duplicate billing from deferred toolcall overlap". Assigned to @sam.

leo: Also add telemetry dimension for routing_policy and handoff_count so we can see if certain paths cause more dupes.

devex-jess: I'll draft console copy and the provisional/confirmed toggle. Also propose an alert when weekly delta > 1% for any paying account.

sam: Will send PR with tests and a canary rollout plan. Nina, please attach the sample trace to the ticket.

nina: attached. thanks.
